title: NORPART - Norwegian Partnership Programme for Global Academic Cooperation
provider: Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir)
description: Programme funding student exchange between Norwegian institutions and partners in the Global South. Individual students cannot apply directly; mobility grants are administered through an active NORPART project at the student's home institution.
amount: Mobility grant covering travel and a monthly subsistence allowance during the exchange

title: University of Oslo PhD Research Fellowships
description: Salaried PhD positions (stipendiat) advertised by University of Oslo faculties on a rolling basis, open to applicants of any nationality holding a relevant master's degree. In Norway doctoral candidates are employees, not students.
amount: Full-time employment contract with a salary of roughly NOK 530,000 per year plus pension and social security

title: NTNU PhD Research Fellowships
provider: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
field: Engineering, natural sciences, technology, social sciences, humanities
description: Salaried PhD positions advertised by NTNU departments throughout the year against specific research projects, open to international applicants with a relevant master's degree.
amount: Full-time employment contract with a salary of roughly NOK 530,000 per year plus pension and social security

title: BI Norwegian Business School Presidential Scholarship
field: Business, economics, finance, data science, strategic marketing
description: Merit scholarship for outstanding international applicants to a full-time Master of Science programme at BI Norwegian Business School.
amount: 50% to 100% tuition fee reduction for the two-year programme

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Norway-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Norwegian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
